claims_supported: An Oracle ledger entry requires the PriceOracle amendment.
The Provider field is an arbitrary string identifying a publisher; the protocol reference does not establish an independent provider-registry attestation.
An Oracle can hold up to 10 asset pairs and carries LastUpdateTime as Unix time.

fixCleanup3_4_0.confirmation: XRPL Dashboard, XRPLWin and Bithomp display the same ledger and activation time.
fixCleanup3_4_0.interpretation: A protocol cleanup/fix amendment is active. This is not evidence that native lending, SingleAssetVault or a new XRP collateral market is active.

native_lending.implication: No native XRPL lending utilization or lending yield should be inferred from fixCleanup3_4_0 activation.

full_directory_disagreement.explanation: XRPL Dashboard reports a curated production cohort; XRPLWin reports a broader directory. The visible provider data on XRPLWin is stale to November 1. These counts are not directly comparable.

price_oracles.protocol_risk: A native oracle object is not automatically a fresh, independently governed or institutionally accepted collateral price feed.

market_observation.interpretation: The Kraken ticker and XRPL Dashboard header are separate observations with different providers and retrieval times. The on-ledger DIA oracle value is older still. No synchronized multi-venue or full-depth snapshot exists.

source_disagreement: The XRPL Dashboard curated price-oracle view reports one production provider and two oracle objects, while XRPLWin's broader directory lists four providers and 153 active pairs; the XRPLWin visible updates are dated November 1, so this is a scope-and-freshness disagreement rather than proof that either count is wrong.

The dashboard header price ($1.2998 at 20:04 UTC), Kraken ticker ($1.30374 retrieved around 20:02 UTC), and DIA Oracle price ($1.3038 last updated 18:57:53 UTC) are not synchronized and must not be averaged.
fixCleanup3_4_0 is active, but the lending amendments remain below the 29-vote threshold and have no current activation countdown.
next_actions: Capture direct validated-ledger and account_objects/feature RPC responses with raw-byte SHA-256 receipts once the public ingestion runtime is authorized and available.
Track SingleAssetVault, LendingProtocol and LendingProtocolV1_1 independently; do not treat the cleanup amendment as lending activation.
Require oracle LastUpdateTime, provider identity and freshness checks before any on-ledger collateral feature is admitted to the feature store.
Keep all current page-rendered observations outside the prediction dataset until byte-complete receipts and point-in-time timestamps are stored.
